preview: In this episode, we look at the debate over assigned desks and shared seating. Why does this choice matter at work, and what can a desk mean to the person using it?
comment_1: Even a familiar workplace can feel very different from one person to another.
comment_2: The question asks how the same office can feel different to different people. Now, you will hear two voices, one after the other, each speaking from a different point of view.
comment_3: You have heard two people describe their experience of the same workplace. The question now is not which voice is right. It is why the same situation can feel different to different people.
comment_4: Instead of asking who is right, let’s ask what is making this situation feel different for each person. That question takes us below the surface of the disagreement.
